profile.summary: A retrospective comparison from the RhoFold+ paper on the six natural RNA targets of CASP15. For each of ten methods or CASP15 groups it reports per-target r.m.s.d. and the sum of Z-scores for GDT-TS and TM score, taking the best of five models. It is one paper's table, useful for seeing how RhoFold+ and other RNA 3D predictors did on these six targets.

sections.title: What it measures
sections.body: How close predicted 3D structures of single-chain natural RNAs come to the CASP15 reference structures, per target and summed in CASP15's Z-score style. Designed targets and RNA-protein complexes were left out as outside RhoFold+'s domain.

sections.title: How it is built
sections.body: The targets are R1107, R1108, R1116, R1117, R1149 and R1156. The comparison set holds CASP15 groups (server and expert, including AIchemy_RNA, the authors' preliminary RhoFold entry) and published methods. Five models per method were collected: RhoFold+ was run five times with different sampled MSAs, AlphaFold3 once (five models), and other methods' models were taken from the CASP15 website. Two methods lack reported values for R1107 and R1108, giving eight N/A entries.

quotes.text: Our preliminary model, AIchemy_RNA (RhoFold), was a participant in the ‘expert’ category.
CASP15 groups were divided into two categories, ‘server’ and ‘expert’, depending on whether or not human expert knowledge and fine tuning were used.
For RhoFold+, we ran it five times with different sampled MSAs, and for the other methods, we collected their five models from CASP15 website.
For AlphaFold3, which generates five models per input sequence per run, we conducted one run and collected the five models.

sections.title: Evaluation methodology
sections.body: Following CASP15 guidelines, the best of up to five models per method is scored. The table reports r.m.s.d. per target (lower is better) and the sum of Z-scores for GDT-TS and TM score per target (higher is better), computed across CASP15 participants. Inputs were RNA sequences only.

notes: One paper's comparison table, not a maintained benchmark; no leaderboard. The CSV is a derived text form of the Source Data workbook so cells can be quoted; the workbook is kept as source-data-fig2.xlsx. The workbook labels AIchemy as 'Alchemy'. Z-score cells carry floating-point artefacts (for example 4.5199999999999996), copied as stored. code_url and code_licence refer to RhoFold+ itself; no code for the comparison was found.
